name: The Westin Charlotte
positioning: An Uptown Charlotte hotel steps from the Convention Center and Bank of America Stadium, with Gold Rush-inspired rooms and city views
best_for: Convention-goers and sports fans who want to stay steps from the Convention Center, Bank of America Stadium and Spectrum Center
Wellness-minded travelers who want a light-filled gym, guided runs and gear lending

facts.text: Brooklyn Village Station on the LYNX light rail is right outside the hotel.
The hotel is steps from Spectrum Center.
Bathrooms have rain showers and Westin White Tea Heavenly amenities, and rooms have the Westin Heavenly Bed.
A Run Concierge leads a complimentary guided run through Uptown every Wednesday from the lobby.
A Gear Lending Program offers fitness, strength-training and recovery equipment.
Dogwood Southern Table serves Southern classics with contemporary flair, inspired by a Southern garden.
Cardinal Coffeehouse in the lobby serves Enderly Coffee Company roasts and pastries.
Dogs up to 50 pounds are welcome, up to two per room, with complimentary treats.

highlights.text: The hotel is in Uptown Charlotte, steps from the Charlotte Convention Center and Bank of America Stadium.
Room design uses subtle gold accents honoring Charlotte's past as the heart of the Carolina Gold Rush and green tones echoing the city's parks.
Many rooms have sweeping views of downtown, and suites on the upper floors have skyline views.
The Westin Club Lounge has an outdoor terrace with city views and offers breakfast, hors d'oeuvres and a bar with craft beers and cocktails.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio has treadmills, TRX, Peloton bikes and free weights, with city views through floor-to-ceiling windows.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Charlotte Douglas International Airport is about 15 minutes away.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may have limited outdoor recreational space.
